findings.citation: `now` and `templateName` keep working, and other (unrecognised) option fields are ignored.
findings.description: The `valid, absent and null stages keep their verdicts` check supplies extra fields but projects only `stage` and `authoritative`, so an implementation may let those fields alter the mismatch answer, timestamp, or template name and still pass.

No check verifies the existing non-empty output of `describeMismatch`; the export-preservation check only verifies that the symbol exists, so its user-facing descriptions can be changed or broken without detection.

findings.citation: One entry per distinct defect, each with a non-empty `location` and `defect`.
findings.description: The `ledger entries are well formed, one per distinct defect` check validates only non-empty strings and duplicate categories; it does not verify that `location` identifies the defective function or that `defect` is the required accurate one-sentence description.

publicationScope: Admission judgments and native outcome metadata only; prompts, raw streams, HTTP bodies, configuration and credential state excluded.
